subject: RECORD clause
notes: 'Integer-3 shall be greater than integer-2' - GREATER, so EQUAL bounds violate it too, and that arm has its own negative because it is where an off-by-one screen passes its inverted-range test and still ships wrong (the standard writes the weaker relation explicitly two rules later, in SR7's 'greater than or equal to zero'). Before kb/Work PB721 `RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 20 TO 5` compiled clean at every edition and the program learned about it only as an I-O status '44' on the first WRITE - 13.18.43.4 GR14 a)'s runtime CONSEQUENCE, never the clause's diagnosis.
